IDENTITY: verified on four criteria from the named hospital's own site - name ('Dr. D. Sainath'), specialty (Conservative, Cosmetic & Endodontist - exactly the input row's wording), hospital (Yashoda Hospitals) and unit/city (Hitec City, Hyderabad) - with qualifications and dates that fit the stated 16 years (BDS Davangere 2006, MDS Saveetha Chennai 2009, Professor at SVS Institute of Dental Sciences 2009-2024). ACADEMIC CORROBORATION: an exact-name query surfaced a PubMed Central paper co-authored by 'Sainath Dinapadu' of the Department of Conservative Dentistry & Endodontics, SVS Institute of Dental Sciences, Mahaboobnagar - the same department at the same institute where his Yashoda profile says he was Professor, which both expands his initial 'D.' to the surname Dinapadu and confirms he is research-active in endodontics.

WHY MEDIUM AND NOT HIGH: every page that confirms the row's own facts (Yashoda, Hitec City, chief dental consultant, endodontics) is on ONE official domain, yashodahospitals.com - and per the brief, several pages on one hospital domain is still a single official source. The PMC paper is a genuinely independent official (NIH) source, but it corroborates his FORMER SVS academic affiliation via an inferred initial-expansion (D. = Dinapadu), not the current Yashoda post, so I did not count it as a second confirmation of the row. Band is therefore Medium, honestly.
